rows.current_behavior: All 236 current transaction contracts are bound to explicit maintainer-reviewed semantic snapshots.
rows.target_behavior: All transaction contracts receive reviewed exact semantics.
rows.title: Transaction contract semantics

rows.current_behavior: All 162 current route contracts are bound to explicit maintainer-reviewed semantic snapshots.
rows.target_behavior: Every public route has explicit reviewed metadata.
rows.title: Route contract semantics

rows.current_behavior: W1 machine-verification closure is complete; independent external review remains a launch-authorization gate and is not represented as completed.
rows.target_behavior: Independent reviewer signs same-commit W1 evidence before launch authorization.
rows.title: Independent review evidence

rows.current_behavior: The bounded controlled-testnet ballot profile enforces frozen Tier-2 or single-group electorates, first-ballot finality, aggregate-only canonical choice state, and separate participation nullifiers. Public-testnet and Mainnet profiles remain disabled pending production sealed-ballot review and activation evidence.
rows.target_behavior: Production universal sealed ballots with metadata resistance, independent review, and activation receipts across every civic voting surface.
rows.title: Controlled-testnet ballot and electorate implementation overlay

rows.current_behavior: The bounded controlled-testnet review profile deterministically assigns severity-sized panels, substitutes, conflict exclusions, fresh disjoint appeal panels, delayed full-panel repair, aggregate-only ballots, and deterministic report-escalation repair.
rows.target_behavior: Production reviewed dispute mechanics with independent adversarial evidence, multi-node replay evidence, and launch authorization.
rows.title: Controlled-testnet review and report-liveness implementation overlay

truth_boundary: The exact uploaded v2.0 First Draft PDF is retained and hash-bound. Its extracted full-scope registers control W1 human-machine equality. Structural compiler coverage does not prove runtime correctness, independent review, interoperability, capacity, or production activation.
